reading.title: Currency and account words
reading.text: Dina reads a bank information sheet. A coin is metal money, while a bill is a banknote. The sheet describes US coins such as the nickel. Dollar, euro, pound and yen name currencies. Dina asks about a checking account for everyday payments. She already keeps some savings. She asks what deposit and withdrawal mean before she reads the account terms. The lesson explains words rather than recommending an account.

reading.title: Understanding financial outcomes
reading.text: Dina reads four terms on an information sheet. Insurance provides agreed cover under a policy's conditions. Investment means committing money in the hope of a return. Profit is the amount left when revenue exceeds costs. Loss can occur when costs exceed revenue. Dina notices that investment does not promise profit and that insurance has conditions. She reads the meanings and asks for an explanation of unfamiliar terms.
